_comment: Candidate install locations only. Every candidate still passes the executable trust checks in review_diagnostics.py. Entries must be absolute or start with ~/ .

provider_timeout._comment: goodqa#16947: per-provider review deadline in seconds, by reviewer rung (by_rung wins) then effort. The run budget is twice the deadline (the primary plus one fallback). The code ceiling is 3600; a malformed entry falls back to 720. The larger budgets are an assumption: finished R2-R4 durations before this change were cut off at the old 720 second cap.
